author: yoshivdk
format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-NALP "Super Smash Bros.", 1 file: RAM_NALP 32768 bytes - RAM_NALP is the N64 cartridge save in console byte order

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert super-smash-bros.26527.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes RAM_NALP (32768 bytes, SRAM): first 0x8000 bytes, 32-bit words reversed, at 0x20800

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save: 8 fighters and four ? on the character select

mupen64plus-next.detail: VS character select shows all 12 fighters (Luigi, Captain Falcon, Ness, Jigglypuff unlocked; 8 and four ? with no save)

parallel-n64.detail: VS character select shows all 12 fighters (Luigi, Captain Falcon, Ness, Jigglypuff unlocked; 8 and four ? with no save)

mupen64plus.detail: VS character select shows all 12 fighters (Luigi, Captain Falcon, Ness, Jigglypuff unlocked; 8 and four ? with no save)

note: RAM_NALP: the SRAM in console order; untouched bytes AA.
